        listagg(distinct case when rn > 1 then place_name end, ' | ') as also_listed_as
    from places_ranked
    group by 1
),

places_only as (
    select
        p.venue_id,
        coalesce(pn.venue_name, p.place_name)                 as venue_name,   -- a hand-checked place name beats the operator's listing
        case when pn.venue_name is not null then 'manual' else 'places_directory' end as name_source,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as name_feature_kind,
        'places_only'                                         as venue_source,
        0                                                     as court_records,
        1                                                     as facility_records,
        p.lat, p.lon,
        coalesce(p.website, x.any_website, bm.website)        as website,
        coalesce(p.phone, x.any_phone)                        as phone,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as opening_hours,
        coalesce(p.address_line, x.any_address)               as address_line,
        p.city,
        p.region,
        bm.offerings                                          as offerings,
        false as has_lit_courts, coalesce(bm.is_public, false) as is_confirmed_public, false as has_free_courts,
        (coalesce(bm.is_members, false) and not coalesce(bm.is_public, false)) as is_members_only,
        cast(null as boolean) as has_indoor, false as has_outdoor,   -- an Overture place says nothing about indoor/outdoor: unknown, not "outdoor"
        'unknown'                                             as indoor_basis,
        false as has_hard, false as has_clay, false as has_grass, false as has_turf, false as has_sand, false as has_indoor_floor,
        case when pn.venue_name is not null
             then concat_ws(' | ', p.place_name, x.also_listed_as) else x.also_listed_as end as also_listed_as
    from places_ranked p
    join place_group_extra x on x.venue_id = p.venue_id
    left join best_manual bm on bm.venue_id = p.venue_id
    left join {{ ref('venue_name_official') }} pn
        on pn.venue_id = p.venue_id
       and abs(p.lat - cast(pn.lat as double)) < 0.0003 and abs(p.lon - cast(pn.lon as double)) < 0.0003
    where p.rn = 1
),

-- Hand-curated venues (seeds/manual_venues.csv): one row per venue, with what it offers.
manual_final as (
    select
        venue_id,
        min(venue_name)                                       as venue_name,
        'manual'                                              as name_source,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as name_feature_kind,
        'manual'                                              as venue_source,
        coalesce(max(courts_count), 0)                        as court_records,
        1                                                     as facility_records,
        min(lat)                                              as lat,
        min(lon)                                              as lon,
        min(website)                                          as website,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as phone,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as opening_hours,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as address_line,
        min(city)                                             as city,
        min(region)                                           as region,
        min(offerings)                                        as offerings,
        false as has_lit_courts,
        max(case when access_type = 'public' then 1 else 0 end) = 1 as is_confirmed_public,
        false as has_free_courts,
        max(case when access_type in ('private', 'members') then 1 else 0 end) = 1
            and max(case when access_type = 'public' then 1 else 0 end) = 0 as is_members_only,
        case when max(case when setting = 'indoor' then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then true
             when max(case when setting in ('outdoor', 'covered') then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then false end as has_indoor,   -- blank / unknown / likely_outdoor = unknown
        max(case when setting in ('outdoor', 'likely_outdoor', 'covered') then 1 else 0 end) = 1 as has_outdoor,
        case when max(case when setting in ('indoor', 'outdoor', 'covered') then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then 'manual_seed' else 'unknown' end as indoor_basis,
        max(case when surface_type = 'hard' then 1 else 0 end) = 1    as has_hard,
        max(case when surface_type = 'clay' then 1 else 0 end) = 1    as has_clay,
        max(case when surface_type = 'grass' then 1 else 0 end) = 1   as has_grass,
        max(case when surface_type = 'turf' then 1 else 0 end) = 1    as has_turf,
        max(case when surface_type = 'sand' then 1 else 0 end) = 1    as has_sand,
        false as has_indoor_floor,
        cast(null as varchar)                                 as also_listed_as
    from {{ ref('stg_manual_venues') }} m
    join {{ ref('int_manual_venue_match') }} mm on mm.venue_key = m.venue_key
    where not mm.is_matched
    group by m.venue_id
),

unioned as (
    select * from osm_final
    union all
    select * from places_only
    union all
    select * from manual_final
)

select
    u.*,
    'courts'                                                  as venue_kind,
    {{ website_status('u.website', 'wc.status') }}            as website_status,   -- ok | dead | unknown | unchecked; null = no website
    g.google_place_id,                                         -- ID only; the app fetches details live (ADR 0005)
    coalesce(s.sport_count, 0)                                as sport_count
from unioned u
left join sports s on s.venue_id = u.venue_id
left join {{ ref('stg_google_place_ids') }} g on g.venue_id = u.venue_id
left join {{ ref('stg_website_checks') }} wc on wc.domain = {{ website_domain('u.website') }}

model.courtconnect.int_venue_sport_walls.name: int_venue_sport_walls
model.courtconnect.int_venue_sport_walls.description: Sports a hitting wall supports, per venue (ADR 0032): the court venue the wall links to, else its own wall venue. Sports come from the wall's type (seeds/wall_type_sports.csv), inferred from the structure and never confirmed play; courts = number of walls.
model.courtconnect.int_venue_sport_walls.raw_code:
-- Sports a hitting wall supports, per venue (ADR 0032): a wall pin counts for the court venue it links to, else for its own wall venue.
-- The sports come from the wall's type (seeds/wall_type_sports.csv): INFERRED from the structure, never confirmed play. `courts` is the
-- number of walls. A type the seed does not list (the unchecked "handball-type" walls) supports nothing; public_only sports (Knuckle
-- Racket) need the wall marked public.
with pins as (
    select
        w.wall_key,
        coalesce(l.venue_id, md5('wall:' || w.wall_key)) as venue_id,
        w.wall_count,
        w.access,
        unnest(string_split(w.wall_type, ';'))           as wall_type
    from {{ ref('mart_wall_pins') }} w
    left join {{ ref('int_wall_venue_link') }} l on l.wall_key = w.wall_key
)

select
    p.venue_id,
    s.sport_id,
    sum(p.wall_count)::integer as courts
from pins p
join {{ ref('wall_type_sports') }} t on t.wall_type = p.wall_type
join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_name = t.sport
where lower(trim(coalesce(t.public_only, ''))) <> 'yes' or p.access = 'public'
group by 1, 2

model.courtconnect.dim_venue.name: dim_venue
model.courtconnect.dim_venue.description: One row per venue: court facilities (OSM courts grouped by proximity, ADR 0003, plus Overture places, ADR 0005, plus hand-added rows) and the hitting walls that stand at no listed venue (ADR 0032). A wall at a listed venue adds its sports to that venue instead.

venue_kind.name: venue_kind
venue_kind.description: courts = a court facility; hitting_wall = a wall pin that stands at no listed venue (ADR 0032).

indoor_basis.name: indoor_basis
indoor_basis.description: Where has_indoor comes from. has_indoor is true/false only with a basis; null (unknown) otherwise. page_quote and footprint are reserved for later evidence.

region.name: region
region.description: A state code from the regions var (CA, NV; ADR 0014, 0028), from the state border polygon at extract time, or the seed's region column for hand-added venues.

model.courtconnect.bridge_venue_sport.name: bridge_venue_sport
model.courtconnect.bridge_venue_sport.description: Which sports are played at which venue, and which source (OSM, places, manual or a hitting wall) says so. in_wall = inferred from a wall's type (ADR 0032), never confirmed play.
model.courtconnect.bridge_venue_sport.raw_code:
-- Which sports are played at which venue, and which source says so: the court sources (OSM, places, manual; int_venue_sport_courts)
-- plus hitting walls (in_wall, ADR 0032). A wall adds a sport to the venue it stands at; where a court source already lists the sport
-- the larger count wins (not the sum), like manual vs OSM. in_courts = a court source (or a rule derived from one) lists the pair; a pair
-- that only a wall supports has in_courts false, and the marts that feed the export keep reading in_courts until the export reads walls.
select
    venue_id,
    sport_id,
    max(courts)        as courts,
    bool_or(in_osm)    as in_osm,
    bool_or(in_places) as in_places,
    bool_or(in_manual) as in_manual,
    bool_or(in_wall)   as in_wall,
    bool_or(in_courts) as in_courts
from (
    select venue_id, sport_id, courts, in_osm, in_places, in_manual, in_wall, true as in_courts from {{ ref('int_venue_sport_courts') }}
    union all
    select venue_id, sport_id, courts, false, false, false, true, false from {{ ref('int_venue_sport_walls') }}
) u
group by 1, 2

model.courtconnect.int_manual_venue_matc.name: int_manual_venue_match
model.courtconnect.int_manual_venue_matc.description: Links each hand-added venue to the venue it was merged into (or to itself when nothing known is within manual_match_radius_m).

effective_venue_id.name: effective_venue_id
effective_venue_id.description: The venue the hand-added entry ends up on. Must exist in dim_venue, or the entry would silently vanish from the map.

model.courtconnect.int_manual_venue_matc.raw_code:
-- A hand-added venue is often a place we already hold under another source (a park whose courts are in OpenStreetMap,
-- a club Overture lists). Link it to the nearest such venue within `manual_match_radius_m` metres so the map shows ONE pin,
-- enriched by the hand-added details, instead of two. Otherwise it stays a venue of its own.
-- Venues listed in seeds/manual_venue_no_merge.csv never merge (a different business sits within the radius).
{% set radius = var('manual_match_radius_m') %}
{% set cell = radius / 80000.0 %}

with manual as (
    select distinct
        venue_key, venue_id as own_venue_id, lat, lon,
        cast(floor(lat / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cy,
        cast(floor(lon / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cx
    from {{ ref('stg_manual_venues') }}
    where venue_key not in (select venue_key from {{ ref('manual_venue_no_merge') }})
),

known as (
    select md5(k.cluster_label) as venue_id, c.lat, c.lon, 'osm' as matched_source,
           cast(floor(c.lat / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cy, cast(floor(c.lon / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cx
    from {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }} c
    join {{ ref('int_court_clusters') }} k on k.court_id = c.court_id
    union all
    select p.venue_id, p.lat, p.lon, 'places',
           cast(floor(p.lat / {{ cell }}) as bigint), cast(floor(p.lon / {{ cell }}) as bigint)
    from {{ ref('dim_place') }} p
    where p.has_strong_sport
),

offsets as (
    select -1 as d union all select 0 union all select 1
),

candidates as (
    select
        m.venue_key, m.own_venue_id, k.venue_id as matched_venue_id, k.matched_source,
        sqrt(power((m.lat - k.lat) * 110540, 2) + power((m.lon - k.lon) * cos(radians(m.lat)) * 111320, 2)) as distance_m
    from manual m
    cross join offsets dy
    cross join offsets dx
    join known k on k.cy = m.cy + dy.d and k.cx = m.cx + dx.d
),

nearest as (
    select venue_key, matched_venue_id, matched_source, distance_m
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by venue_key order by distance_m, matched_venue_id) as rn
        from candidates
        where distance_m <= {{ radius }}
    ) x
    where rn = 1
)

select
    m.venue_key,
    m.own_venue_id,
    coalesce(n.matched_venue_id, m.own_venue_id)              as effective_venue_id,
    n.matched_venue_id is not null                            as is_matched,
    n.matched_source,
    n.distance_m
from (select distinct venue_key, venue_id as own_venue_id from {{ ref('stg_manual_venues') }}) m
left join nearest n on n.venue_key = m.venue_key

test.courtconnect.assert_every_wall_pin_.name: assert_every_wall_pin_has_one_home
test.courtconnect.assert_every_wall_pin_.raw_code:
-- ADR 0032: every hitting-wall pin is either a feature of one court venue (int_wall_venue_link) or a venue of its own, never both, never neither.
select 'wall_pin_count_mismatch'
where (select count(*) from {{ ref('mart_wall_pins') }})
   <> (select count(*) from {{ ref('int_wall_venue_link') }}) + (select count(*) from {{ ref('int_wall_venue') }})
union all
select w.wall_key
from {{ ref('mart_wall_pins') }} w
join {{ ref('int_wall_venue_link') }} l on l.wall_key = w.wall_key
join {{ ref('int_wall_venue') }} v on v.venue_id = md5('wall:' || w.wall_key)

seed.courtconnect.wall_type_sports.name: wall_type_sports
seed.courtconnect.wall_type_sports.description: Which sports a hitting wall of each type supports (ADR 0032), replacing the app's WALL_SPORT table. Inferred from the wall's structure, never confirmed play. `public_only` = yes means the sport counts only at walls marked public (Knuckle Racket). Wall types not listed (the unchecked handball-type walls) support nothing.

seed.courtconnect.venue_actions.name: venue_actions
seed.courtconnect.venue_actions.description: What you can do at a venue (join a league, take a clinic, find open play, book a lesson), as link-outs to the provider's own page. RacketConnect books nothing. venue_ref_type is 'manual' (venue_ref = venue_key) or 'place' (venue_ref = an Overture place_id).

seed.courtconnect.manual_walls.name: manual_walls
seed.courtconnect.manual_walls.description: Hitting walls for solo practice (one-wall, three-wall, backboards), curated by hand, one row per wall. Blank is_lit / free_to_use = unknown. `confirmation` is reported (owner) or official; coordinates may be approximate (see location_precision).

access.name: access
access.description: Same vocabulary as venues and courts (access_type): public, customers, private (campus programs, apartments, not open to walk-up use), members, or blank = not known.

seed.courtconnect.nominatim_addresses.name: nominatim_addresses
seed.courtconnect.nominatim_addresses.description: Cache of Nominatim reverse geocodes for non-home pins that tiers 1-2 left without a street address. One row per pin queried, misses included, so a rerun never re-queries. Only status 'address' (house number + street within 150 m) is used.

model.courtconnect.int_wall_venue.name: int_wall_venue
model.courtconnect.int_wall_venue.description: Hitting-wall pins that stand at no listed court venue, as venues of their own (ADR 0032; venue_kind 'hitting_wall', venue_source 'walls'), with the same columns as int_venue_court. A pin linked by int_wall_venue_link is a feature of that venue instead, so no pin is listed twice.
model.courtconnect.int_wall_venue.raw_code:
-- The hitting-wall pins that stand at no listed court venue become venues of their own (ADR 0032, venue_kind 'hitting_wall'); a pin
-- int_wall_venue_link ties to a court venue is a feature of that venue instead, so no pin is listed twice. Same columns as
-- int_venue_court so core.dim_venue can union them. A wall says nothing about indoor/outdoor or surface type: unknown, not "outdoor"
-- (the same stance as places_only). Name quality follows the source: a hand-checked report/official row is 'manual', a real OSM name
-- is 'court_name', the generic default is 'unnamed'. Access comes from the wall's own access label, never assumed public.
select
    md5('wall:' || w.wall_key)                                  as venue_id,
    w.wall_name                                                 as venue_name,
    case when w.confirmation in ('reported', 'official') then 'manual'
         when w.wall_name <> 'Handball / wall court' then 'court_name'
         else 'unnamed' end                                     as name_source,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as name_feature_kind,
    'walls'                                                     as venue_source,
    0                                                           as court_records,
    1                                                           as facility_records,
    w.lat,
    w.lon,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as website,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as phone,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as opening_hours,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as address_line,
    nullif(w.city, '')                                          as city,
    w.region,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as offerings,
    coalesce(w.is_lit, false)                                   as has_lit_courts,
    coalesce(w.access = 'public', false)                        as is_confirmed_public,
    coalesce(w.free_to_use, false)                              as has_free_courts,
    coalesce(w.access in ('members', 'private'), false)         as is_members_only,
    cast(null as boolean)                                       as has_indoor,
    false                                                       as has_outdoor,
    'unknown'                                                   as indoor_basis,
    false as has_hard, false as has_clay, false as has_grass, false as has_turf, false as has_sand, false as has_indoor_floor,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as also_listed_as,
    'hitting_wall'                                              as venue_kind,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as website_status,
    cast(null as varchar)                                       as google_place_id,
    w.reported_on                                               as source_seen_on   -- when the wall was extracted from OSM or reported by a person
from {{ ref('mart_wall_pins') }} w
where w.wall_key not in (select wall_key from {{ ref('int_wall_venue_link') }})

model.courtconnect.bridge_court_sport.name: bridge_court_sport
model.courtconnect.bridge_court_sport.raw_code:
-- A court can host several sports (e.g. a tennis court with pickleball lines).
-- Two seed files adjust what the OSM tags say:
--   sport_also_played.csv         : a court tagged sport A is also a court for sport B (racquetball courts host 4-wall paddle)
--   osm_court_sport_overrides.csv : a person found a tag wrong, so that court is not counted for that sport (verdict 'reject');
--                                   optional correct_sport = the sport it really is (e.g. aerial 'padel' tag on pickleball courts)
with tagged as (
    select
        c.court_id,
        c.access_type,
        c.surface_type,
        s.sport_name
    from {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }} c
    cross join unnest(string_split(c.sport_tag_delimited, ';')) as t(tag)   -- equi-join on the tag; the old LIKE '%;key;%' join could not be hashed
    join {{ ref('osm_sport_map') }} m
        on m.osm_sport_key = t.tag
    join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s
        on s.sport_name = m.sport

    union

    -- a rejected tag that a person re-identified (correct_sport): the court counts for the real sport instead
    select
        c.court_id,
        c.access_type,
        c.surface_type,
        trim(o.correct_sport) as sport_name
    from {{ ref('osm_court_sport_overrides') }} o
    join {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }} c on c.court_id = trim(o.court_id)
    where lower(trim(o.verdict)) = 'reject'
      and nullif(trim(o.correct_sport), '') is not null
),

with_also as (
    select court_id, sport_name from tagged
    union
    select t.court_id, trim(a.also_sport)
    from tagged t
    join {{ ref('sport_also_played') }} a on trim(a.sport) = t.sport_name
    -- a rejected tag passes nothing on either (Venice Beach: Tennis rejected, so no Frescotennis / Loboton / Tennis Triples)
    left join {{ ref('osm_court_sport_overrides') }} r
        on trim(r.court_id) = t.court_id and trim(r.sport) = t.sport_name and lower(trim(r.verdict)) = 'reject'
    -- exclude_private_members = yes: private / members-only courts do not pass the sport on (Pitton on badminton courts)
    where r.court_id is null
      and not (lower(trim(coalesce(a.exclude_private_members, ''))) = 'yes' and t.access_type in ('private', 'members'))
    -- only_surfaces = e.g. grass;turf (Soft Tennis): the court's surface must be listed; an unknown surface does not qualify
      and (nullif(trim(a.only_surfaces), '') is null
           or ';' || replace(a.only_surfaces, ' ', '') || ';' like '%;' || t.surface_type || ';%')
    -- only_access = e.g. public (Micro Pickleball on ping pong tables): the court's access must be listed; unknown access does not qualify
      and (nullif(trim(a.only_access), '') is null
           or ';' || replace(a.only_access, ' ', '') || ';' like '%;' || t.access_type || ';%')
)

select distinct
    w.court_id,
    s.sport_id
from with_also w
join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_name = w.sport_name
left join {{ ref('osm_court_sport_overrides') }} o
    on trim(o.court_id) = w.court_id and trim(o.sport) = w.sport_name and lower(trim(o.verdict)) = 'reject'
where o.court_id is null

model.courtconnect.mart_venue_finder.name: mart_venue_finder
model.courtconnect.mart_venue_finder.description: The table behind the map. One row per venue and sport (a venue with tennis and pickleball has two rows). Venues are clusters of nearby OpenStreetMap courts merged with Overture places and hand-curated entries (ADR 0002, 0003). Exported to app/data/venues.json by ingestion/export_app_data.py.

venue_id.name: venue_id
venue_id.description: Stable id of the venue cluster (dim_venue).

venue_name.name: venue_name
venue_name.description: Best available name. See name_source for how trustworthy it is. An inferred (enclosing_feature) name shared by 2+ venues in a city ends in a computed suffix, "(north courts, 6 courts)" (int_venue_display_name): position and court count, not a source.

name_source.name: name_source
name_source.description: How the name was found: court_name, operator, manual and places_directory are confirmed; enclosing_feature is a guess from the park or school the courts sit in; unnamed has none.

venue_source.name: venue_source
venue_source.description: Where the venue comes from: osm, osm+places, places_only or manual.

sport_name.name: sport_name
sport_name.description: Racket sport from the owner's sheet (the sheet is the source; never hand-edited).

courts_for_sport.name: courts_for_sport
courts_for_sport.description: Number of mapped courts for that sport. Sports that share physical courts (see sport_also_played) are not extra courts.

is_confirmed_public.name: is_confirmed_public
is_confirmed_public.description: True only when the data marks the courts public. False means unknown, not private.

is_members_only.name: is_members_only
is_members_only.description: True when the courts are marked private or members and not marked public. Incomplete by design; an unmarked club is not flagged.

website_usable.name: website_usable
website_usable.description: Website that passed the liveness check; dead links never reach the map.

model.courtconnect.mart_venue_finder.raw_code:
-- What the app queries: one row per (venue, sport) with the facts a player cares about:
-- how many courts, which surfaces (hard / clay / grass / sand / ...), indoor and/or outdoor, plus where the data came from.
with osm_facts as (
    select
        c.venue_id,
        b.sport_id,
        case when max(case when c.setting = 'indoor' then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then true
             when max(case when c.setting in ('outdoor', 'covered') then 1 else 0 end) = 1 then false end as has_indoor,   -- null = unknown
        max(case when c.setting in ('outdoor', 'likely_outdoor', 'covered') then 1 else 0 end) = 1  as has_outdoor,
        max(case when c.surface_type = 'sand' then 1 else 0 end) = 1                                as has_sand_beach,
        max(case when c.surface_type = 'clay' then 1 else 0 end) = 1                                as has_clay,
        max(case when c.surface_type = 'grass' then 1 else 0 end) = 1                               as has_grass,
        max(case when c.surface_type = 'hard' then 1 else 0 end) = 1                                as has_hard,
        max(case when c.surface_type = 'turf' then 1 else 0 end) = 1                                as has_turf
    from {{ ref('dim_court') }} c
    join {{ ref('bridge_court_sport') }} b on b.court_id = c.court_id
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    v.venue_id,
    coalesce(dn.display_name, v.venue_name, 'Unnamed courts')  as venue_name,   -- same-name inferred pins get a computed position + court-count suffix (int_venue_display_name); name_source stays inferred
    v.name_source,
    v.venue_source,
    v.venue_kind,
    s.sport_name,
    bvs.courts                                                as courts_for_sport,
    bvs.in_osm,
    bvs.in_places,
    bvs.in_manual,
    bvs.in_wall,
    bvs.in_courts,
    v.offerings,
    v.lat,
    v.lon,
    a.city,                                                   -- venue city, else the nearest address point's city
    v.region,                                                 -- CA / NV (ADR 0014)
    a.address_line,                                           -- own address, else the nearest Overture address (inferred); never a street for home-like pins
    a.address_source,
    a.address_distance_m,
    a.near_street,                                            -- road name only (inferred), for pins with no address; shown as "Near <street>"
    v.website,
    v.website_status,
    case when v.website_status = 'dead' then null else v.website end   as website_usable,   -- hides links to domains that no longer exist
    v.phone,
    v.opening_hours,
    v.google_place_id,
    -- court-level facts come from OSM; hand-curated venues carry their own surface and setting
    case when v.venue_source = 'manual' then v.has_indoor else f.has_indoor end                       as has_indoor,   -- null = unknown (the export treats it as "not indoor")
    case when v.venue_source = 'manual' then v.indoor_basis when f.has_indoor is not null then 'osm_tag' else 'unknown' end as indoor_basis,
    case when v.venue_source = 'manual' then v.has_outdoor else coalesce(f.has_outdoor, false) end   as has_outdoor,
    case when v.venue_source = 'manual' then v.has_sand else coalesce(f.has_sand_beach, false) end   as has_sand_beach,
    coalesce(f.has_clay, false)                               as has_clay,
    coalesce(f.has_grass, false)                              as has_grass,
    coalesce(f.has_hard, false)                               as has_hard,
    coalesce(f.has_turf, false)                               as has_turf,
    v.has_lit_courts,
    v.is_confirmed_public,
    v.has_free_courts,
    v.is_members_only,
    v.also_listed_as
from {{ ref('bridge_venue_sport') }} bvs
join {{ ref('dim_venue') }} v on v.venue_id = bvs.venue_id
join {{ ref('int_venue_address') }} a on a.venue_id = bvs.venue_id
left join {{ ref('int_venue_display_name') }} dn on dn.venue_id = bvs.venue_id
join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_id = bvs.sport_id
left join osm_facts f on f.venue_id = bvs.venue_id and f.sport_id = bvs.sport_id
-- exclude_private_members = yes (Pitton on badminton courts): a members-only venue does not get the sport by inference, even when its
-- own court is unmarked; a seed row that lists the sport itself is kept.
-- Hitting walls (ADR 0032) are rows here too: venue_kind 'hitting_wall' venues, and wall-supported sports at court venues (in_wall, not in_courts).
-- The export still lists court venues only (step 3 of the plan turns the walls on), so it filters on venue_kind.
where not (
    v.is_members_only
    and not bvs.in_manual
    and s.sport_name in (select trim(also_sport) from {{ ref('sport_also_played') }} where lower(trim(coalesce(exclude_private_members, ''))) = 'yes')
)

model.courtconnect.int_wall_venue_link.name: int_wall_venue_link
model.courtconnect.int_wall_venue_link.description: Links a hitting-wall pin to the one listed venue it stands at (by `near_venue_name`, else nearest within `wall_venue_link_radius_m`), for the venue popup's "Hitting walls on site" line. A pointer only: walls are not courts and move no venue or sport count.

venue_id.name: venue_id
venue_id.description: A venue the app lists (no orphan ids).

model.courtconnect.int_wall_venue_link.raw_code:
-- Links each hitting-wall map pin to the one court venue it stands at (ADR 0032): the wall becomes a feature of that venue
-- ("Hitting walls on site") and its sports join the venue's. A wall pin links to at most one venue: the venue whose name equals the
-- pin's `near_venue_name` (within `wall_venue_link_name_radius_m`), else the nearest venue within `wall_venue_link_radius_m`; no match,
-- no link, and the pin is a venue of its own (int_wall_venue).
-- Only court venues the app lists (the ones in int_venue_sport_courts) can be linked. Names are matched on the venue's own name; the
-- computed display name (int_venue_display_name) only adds a position suffix to same-name pins, which a wall's `near_venue_name` never has.
with venues as (
    select
        v.venue_id,
        lower(trim(v.venue_name)) as shown_name,
        v.lat,
        v.lon
    from {{ ref('int_venue_court') }} v
    where v.venue_id in (select venue_id from {{ ref('int_venue_sport_courts') }})
      and v.lat is not null and v.lon is not null
),

candidates as (
    select
        w.wall_key,
        v.venue_id,
        coalesce(lower(trim(w.near_venue_name)) = v.shown_name, false) as name_match,
        sqrt(
              power((w.lat - v.lat) * 110540, 2)
            + power((w.lon - v.lon) * cos(radians(w.lat)) * 111320, 2)
        ) as distance_m
    from {{ ref('mart_wall_pins') }} w
    join venues v
        on abs(v.lat - w.lat) < 0.01
       and abs(v.lon - w.lon) < 0.01
),

ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by wall_key order by name_match desc, distance_m, venue_id) as rn
    from candidates
    where (name_match and distance_m <= {{ var('wall_venue_link_name_radius_m') }})
       or distance_m <= {{ var('wall_venue_link_radius_m') }}
)

select
    wall_key,
    venue_id,
    case when name_match then 'name' else 'distance' end as link_basis,
    round(distance_m)::integer                           as distance_m
from ranked
where rn = 1

model.courtconnect.mart_sport_coverage.name: mart_sport_coverage
model.courtconnect.mart_sport_coverage.description: "How complete is our data?" One row per racket sport, including sports with zero venues found. venues_found counts only evidence we trust: OSM courts and places with a racket category or a distinctive sport word.
model.courtconnect.mart_sport_coverage.raw_code:
-- "How complete is our data?" One row per racket sport, including sports with zero venues found.
-- venues_found counts only evidence we trust: OSM courts, and places with a racket category or a distinctive sport word.
with weak as (
    select sport_id, count(distinct place_id) as weak_places
    from {{ ref('bridge_place_sport') }}
    where evidence = 'weak'
    group by 1
)

-- Hitting walls (ADR 0032) are counted apart: wall_venues_found = venues, wall venues and court venues alike, where a wall's type makes the sport playable.
-- venues_found and the other counts stay court-sourced until the export turns the walls on.
select
    s.sport_name,
    s.popularity_class,
    count(distinct bvs.venue_id)                                                       as venues_found,
    count(distinct case when bvs.in_osm then bvs.venue_id end)                         as osm_venues,
    count(distinct case when bvs.in_places then bvs.venue_id end)                      as places_venues,
    count(distinct case when bvs.in_manual then bvs.venue_id end)                      as manual_venues,
    count(distinct case when bvs.in_osm and bvs.in_places then bvs.venue_id end)       as venues_in_both,
    coalesce(sum(bvs.courts), 0)                                                       as courts_found,
    count(distinct case when v.is_confirmed_public then bvs.venue_id end)              as public_venues,
    count(distinct case when v.name_source = 'unnamed' then bvs.venue_id end)          as venues_missing_name,
    count(distinct case when v.name_source <> 'unnamed' then bvs.venue_id end)         as venues_named,
    coalesce(max(w.weak_places), 0)                                                    as weak_name_matches,
    coalesce(max(wv.wall_venues_found), 0)                                             as wall_venues_found
from {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s
left join {{ ref('bridge_venue_sport') }} bvs on bvs.sport_id = s.sport_id and bvs.in_courts   -- hitting walls join the totals with the export (ADR 0032 step 2)
left join {{ ref('dim_venue') }} v on v.venue_id = bvs.venue_id
left join weak w on w.sport_id = s.sport_id
left join (
    select sport_id, count(distinct venue_id) as wall_venues_found from {{ ref('bridge_venue_sport') }} where in_wall group by 1
) wv on wv.sport_id = s.sport_id
where s.sport_family like 'Racket%'
group by 1, 2

model.courtconnect.mart_sport_evidence.name: mart_sport_evidence
model.courtconnect.mart_sport_evidence.description: Sport-evidence ladder: per (venue, sport) the strongest evidence rung (1 confirmed ... 7 derived), how many rungs agree, and whether the label needs review (rung 4 loose OSM tag or rung 6 name-only). Our ranking, not a claim by the venue. Not exported to the map yet.
model.courtconnect.mart_sport_evidence.raw_code:
-- Sport-evidence ladder: for each (venue, sport), the STRONGEST reason we think the sport is played there, and how many rungs agree.
-- Why: a sport label can be wrong while the venue is right (2026-10-13: OSM `pelota` was read as Peruvian Paleta frontón at Basque clubs).
-- A label resting on the lowest rungs is a candidate for review, and the confidence score can use the rung instead of treating all labels alike.
--   rung 1  confirmed   : hand-added venue with confirmation visited / official, or a human 'confirm' in place_sport_overrides
--   rung 2  reported    : hand-added venue, confirmation reported (owner / community report)
--   rung 3  osm_tag     : OpenStreetMap `sport=` tag we map with HIGH confidence (osm_sport_map)
--   rung 4  osm_tag_loose : OSM tag mapped with MEDIUM confidence (tag is a family name, e.g. pelota, paddle_tennis)
--   rung 5  overture_category : Overture classifies the place as a racket venue for that sport
--   rung 6  name_keyword : a distinctive sport word in the business name (inferred from the name only)
--   rung 7  derived     : only reachable through sport_also_played (a pickleball court is also a Skyball court) or a hitting wall's type (wall_type_sports, ADR 0032); an inference, not a sighting
-- Weak (ambiguous) name matches are not venues and never appear here. Rungs 1-2 come from people, 3-6 from datasets, 7 from rules.
with osm as (
    select distinct
        c.venue_id,
        s.sport_id,
        case when m.confidence = 'high' then 3 else 4 end as rung
    from {{ ref('dim_court') }} c
    join {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }} t on t.court_id = c.court_id
    join {{ ref('osm_sport_map') }} m on t.sport_tag_delimited like '%;' || m.osm_sport_key || ';%'
    join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_name = m.sport
    left join {{ ref('osm_court_sport_overrides') }} o
        on trim(o.court_id) = c.court_id and trim(o.sport) = s.sport_name and lower(trim(o.verdict)) = 'reject'
    where o.court_id is null

    union

    -- a human re-identified a wrong OSM tag (correct_sport), from imagery or a page: counts as a loose label, so it stays in the review queue
    select distinct c.venue_id, s.sport_id, 4 as rung
    from {{ ref('osm_court_sport_overrides') }} o
    join {{ ref('dim_court') }} c on c.court_id = trim(o.court_id)
    join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_name = trim(o.correct_sport)
    where lower(trim(o.verdict)) = 'reject'
      and nullif(trim(o.correct_sport), '') is not null
),

places as (
    select distinct
        p.venue_id,
        bp.sport_id,
        case
            when bp.match_type = 'manual' then 1
            when bp.match_type = 'category' then 5
            when bp.match_type = 'name_keyword' then 6
        end as rung
    from {{ ref('dim_place') }} p
    join {{ ref('bridge_place_sport') }} bp on bp.place_id = p.place_id and bp.evidence = 'strong'
    where bp.match_type in ('manual', 'category', 'name_keyword')
),

manual as (
    select
        mm.effective_venue_id as venue_id,
        s.sport_id,
        min(case when m.confirmation_level in ('visited', 'official') then 1 else 2 end) as rung
    from {{ ref('stg_manual_venues') }} m
    join {{ ref('int_manual_venue_match') }} mm on mm.venue_key = m.venue_key
    join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_name = m.sport_name
    group by 1, 2
),

direct as (
    select * from osm
    union all select * from places
    union all select * from manual
),

per_pair as (
    select venue_id, sport_id, min(rung) as best_rung, count(distinct rung) as rungs_agreeing
    from direct
    group by 1, 2
),

-- every (venue, sport) the finder knows; pairs with no direct rung are derived (rung 7)
all_pairs as (
    select b.venue_id, b.sport_id, coalesce(p.best_rung, 7) as best_rung, coalesce(p.rungs_agreeing, 0) as rungs_agreeing
    from {{ ref('bridge_venue_sport') }} b
    left join per_pair p on p.venue_id = b.venue_id and p.sport_id = b.sport_id
)

select
    a.venue_id,
    a.sport_id,
    s.sport_name,
    a.best_rung,
    case a.best_rung
        when 1 then 'confirmed' when 2 then 'reported' when 3 then 'osm_tag' when 4 then 'osm_tag_loose'
        when 5 then 'overture_category' when 6 then 'name_keyword' else 'derived'
    end                                               as best_rung_label,
    a.rungs_agreeing,
    -- needs_review: the label rests only on a loose OSM tag or a business-name word, so a wrong label is plausible.
    -- Derived rows (rung 7) are rule outputs documented in sport_also_played.csv, so they are not queued here.
    a.best_rung in (4, 6)                              as needs_review,
    'inferred'                                         as confirmation_note   -- ladder position is our judgement, not a venue's own statement
from all_pairs a
join {{ ref('dim_sport') }} s on s.sport_id = a.sport_id

model.courtconnect.mart_venue_confidence.name: mart_venue_confidence
model.courtconnect.mart_venue_confidence.description: Rule-based confidence score per venue (0-100, method rules_v2, INFERRED): sources, hand-added evidence, real name, contact details and freshness, minus a penalty when sports rest on weak evidence (mart_sport_evidence), each a visible column; v1 score kept for comparison. A heuristic for ranking what to verify next, not a probability and not shown to players yet.

last_seen_on.name: last_seen_on
last_seen_on.description: Newest date any source saw the venue (OSM extract, Overture release, hand-added confirmation, link-out check). Null when nothing dated backs the venue (e.g. an undated reported row). The 35-day freshness SLA in `make quality` reads it.

model.courtconnect.mart_venue_confidence.raw_code:
-- Rule-based confidence score per venue (0-100, rules_v2): how well backed up is the fact that this venue exists with these sports.
-- It is a transparent, INFERRED heuristic ("rules_v2"), not a probability: every point comes from a column you can read here.
--   sources   0-30  one source 10, two 20, three 30 (OpenStreetMap, Overture places, hand-added)
--   evidence  0-25  best hand-added confirmation: visited 25, official 20, reported 8
--   named     0-10  a real name (hand-added, Overture, court name or operator), not a guessed or empty one
--   contact   0-20  usable website 8, phone 4, opening hours 4, address 4
--   fresh     0-15  newest dated check (hand-added confirmation or link-out verification): <=35 days 15, <=90 days 8
--   sport penalty 0 to -15 (added in rules_v2): 15 x the weighted share of the venue's directly evidenced sports that rest only on a loose OSM tag (weight 1) or a
--                 business-name word (weight 0.5; a distinctive word like "padel" is usually right) (mart_sport_evidence.needs_review). Derived sports (sport_also_played) are rule outputs and not counted.
-- last_seen_on: newest date any source saw the venue (OSM extract, Overture release, hand-added confirmation, link-out check); the 35-day
--   freshness SLA in `make quality` reads it. Nulls are coalesced to 1900-01-01 first so one missing date never nulls the greatest().
-- confidence_score_v1 keeps the old score so the effect of the penalty stays visible.
-- Bands: high >= 60, medium 30-59, low < 30.
{% set d0 = "cast('1900-01-01' as date)" %}
with src as (
    select
        venue_id,
        max(case when in_osm then 1 else 0 end)    as has_osm,
        max(case when in_places then 1 else 0 end) as has_places,
        max(case when in_manual then 1 else 0 end) as has_manual
    from {{ ref('bridge_venue_sport') }}
    group by 1
),

manual_ev as (
    select
        mm.effective_venue_id as venue_id,
        max(case m.confirmation_level when 'visited' then 25 when 'official' then 20 else 8 end) as evidence_pts,
        max(m.confirmed_on) as newest_confirmed
    from {{ ref('stg_manual_venues') }} m
    join {{ ref('int_manual_venue_match') }} mm on mm.venue_key = m.venue_key
    group by 1
),

seen as (
    select venue_id, max(cast(extracted_at as date)) as osm_seen_on
    from {{ ref('dim_court') }}
    group by 1
),

place_seen as (
    select venue_id, max(cast(left(release, 10) as date)) as places_seen_on
    from {{ ref('dim_place') }}
    where venue_id is not null
    group by 1
),

action_ev as (
    select venue_id, max(verified_on) as newest_verified
    from {{ ref('mart_venue_actions') }}
    group by 1
),

sport_roll as (
    select
        venue_id,
        sum(case when best_rung < 7 then 1 else 0 end)             as direct_sports,
        sum(case when best_rung = 4 then 1 when best_rung = 6 then 0.5 else 0 end) as review_sports   -- loose tag counts fully, name-only half
    from {{ ref('mart_sport_evidence') }}
    group by 1
),

scored as (
    select
        v.venue_id,
        v.venue_name,
        v.venue_source,
        v.city,
        10 * (coalesce(s.has_osm, 0) + coalesce(s.has_places, 0) + coalesce(s.has_manual, 0) + case when v.venue_kind = 'hitting_wall' then 1 else 0 end) as sources_pts,   -- a wall venue's one source is the wall data (OSM walls or a person's report)
        coalesce(me.evidence_pts, 0)                                                            as evidence_pts,
        case when v.name_source in ('manual', 'places_directory', 'court_name', 'operator') then 10 else 0 end as named_pts,
        (case when v.website is not null and coalesce(v.website_status, '') <> 'dead' then 8 else 0 end
         + case when v.phone is not null then 4 else 0 end
         + case when v.opening_hours is not null then 4 else 0 end
         + case when v.address_line is not null then 4 else 0 end)                              as contact_pts,
        case
            when greatest(coalesce(me.newest_confirmed, {{ d0 }}), coalesce(ae.newest_verified, {{ d0 }})) >= current_date - 35 then 15
            when greatest(coalesce(me.newest_confirmed, {{ d0 }}), coalesce(ae.newest_verified, {{ d0 }})) >= current_date - 90 then 8
            else 0
        end                                                                                     as fresh_pts,
        nullif(greatest(coalesce(me.newest_confirmed, {{ d0 }}), coalesce(ae.newest_verified, {{ d0 }}),
                        coalesce(os.osm_seen_on, {{ d0 }}), coalesce(ps.places_seen_on, {{ d0 }}), coalesce(v.source_seen_on, {{ d0 }})), {{ d0 }}) as last_seen_on,
        coalesce(sr.direct_sports, 0)                                                           as direct_sports,
        coalesce(sr.review_sports, 0)                                                           as review_sports,
        case when coalesce(sr.direct_sports, 0) = 0 then 0
             else cast(round(15.0 * sr.review_sports / sr.direct_sports) as integer) end        as sport_penalty_pts
    from {{ ref('dim_venue') }} v
    left join src s on s.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join manual_ev me on me.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join action_ev ae on ae.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join seen os on os.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join place_seen ps on ps.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join sport_roll sr on sr.venue_id = v.venue_id
)

select
    *,
    sources_pts + evidence_pts + named_pts + contact_pts + fresh_pts                            as confidence_score_v1,
    greatest(0, sources_pts + evidence_pts + named_pts + contact_pts + fresh_pts - sport_penalty_pts) as confidence_score,
    case
        when greatest(0, sources_pts + evidence_pts + named_pts + contact_pts + fresh_pts - sport_penalty_pts) >= 60 then 'high'
        when greatest(0, sources_pts + evidence_pts + named_pts + contact_pts + fresh_pts - sport_penalty_pts) >= 30 then 'medium'
        else 'low'
    end                                                                                         as confidence_band,
    'rules_v2'                                                                                  as score_method,
    'inferred'                                                                                  as confirmation
from scored

model.courtconnect.int_court_parent.name: int_court_parent
model.courtconnect.int_court_parent.description: For each court or facility, the smallest named park, school or club whose bounding box contains it. An approximation, labelled enclosing_feature downstream and never a confirmed court name. Golf courses, resorts and hotels are used only when nothing else contains the court.
model.courtconnect.int_court_parent.raw_code:
-- For each court/facility, the smallest NAMED feature (park, school, club...) whose bounding box contains it.
-- Bounding boxes over-cover irregular shapes, so this is an approximation: it is labelled as
-- 'enclosing_feature' downstream, never as a confirmed court name. Golf courses, resorts and hotels have big
-- irregular bounding boxes that swallow nearby courts, so they are used only when nothing else contains the court.
-- Equi-join on a grid, not a range join: a court is in exactly one ~2 km cell and each box is listed once per cell it
-- covers (~69k rows for ~50k boxes), then the exact bbox test runs. The plain `lat between ... and lon between ...` join
-- compared every court with every box and took ~225 s for 35k x 50k.
{% set cell = 0.02 %}
with parent_cells as (
    select p.*, y.cy, x.cx
    from {{ ref('stg_osm_parents') }} p,
         unnest(generate_series(cast(floor(p.minlat / {{ cell }}) as bigint), cast(floor(p.maxlat / {{ cell }}) as bigint))) as y(cy),
         unnest(generate_series(cast(floor(p.minlon / {{ cell }}) as bigint), cast(floor(p.maxlon / {{ cell }}) as bigint))) as x(cx)
),

matches as (
    select
        c.court_id,
        p.parent_id,
        p.parent_name,
        p.kind_group,
        p.bbox_area_deg2,
        row_number() over (
            partition by c.court_id
            order by case when p.kind_group = 'resort_or_other' then 2 else 1 end,   -- golf courses / hotels only as a last resort
                     p.bbox_area_deg2 asc, p.parent_id
        ) as rn
    from {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }} c
    join parent_cells p
      on p.cy = cast(floor(c.lat / {{ cell }}) as bigint)
     and p.cx = cast(floor(c.lon / {{ cell }}) as bigint)
     and c.lat between p.minlat and p.maxlat
     and c.lon between p.minlon and p.maxlon
)

select court_id, parent_id, parent_name, kind_group as parent_kind, bbox_area_deg2 as parent_area
from matches
where rn = 1

model.courtconnect.int_venue_address.name: int_venue_address
model.courtconnect.int_venue_address.description: One row per venue: the street address to show and where it came from. Venues that already carry an address keep it (address_source osm = tagged on the OSM court, overture_place = the Overture place record). Venues without one get the nearest Overture address point within address_fill_radius_m (address_source overture_nearest, address_distance_m), else a cached Nominatim reverse geocode (address_source nominatim). A street printed on the venue's own official page (seeds/venue_address_official.csv, address_source official) beats the inferred tiers. A pin with no city gets one from the hand-added row, a cached Nominatim lookup, or the nearest Overture address with a city within 1 km (5 km as a last resort for remote pins, then the Census place or county containing the pin), or a person-checked city in seeds/venue_city_official.csv. Home-like pins (is_home_like) never get an inferred street, only a city.

address_distance_m.name: address_distance_m
address_distance_m.description: Metres from the pin to the filled address point; only set when address_source is overture_nearest or nominatim.

model.courtconnect.int_venue_address.raw_code:
-- One row per venue: the street address to show and where it came from (docs/ml_plan.md, address fill).
--   address_source 'osm'              : address tagged on the OSM court itself (kept as is)
--   address_source 'overture_place'   : the Overture place record's address (kept as is)
--   address_source 'osm_parent'       : INFERRED, tier 1b: the address mapped in OSM on the park / school / club that encloses a venue named after it
--                                       (name_source 'enclosing_feature'; name and address then describe the same place). Beats the nearest-point tiers.
--   address_source 'overture_nearest' : INFERRED, the nearest Overture address point within `address_fill_radius_m` of the pin
--   address_source 'nominatim'        : INFERRED, tier 3: OSM's Nominatim reverse geocode of the pin, cached in the nominatim_addresses
--                                       seed (ingestion/reverse_geocode_blanks.py); only a house number + street within 150 m is used,
--                                       and only for non-home pins that tiers 1-2 left blank
--   address_source 'official'         : tier 4, the street printed on the venue's own official page (seeds/venue_address_official.csv, keyed by
--                                       the hand-added venue_key; evidence + verified_on required). Beats the inferred tiers and is shown as fact.
--   near_street: a pin that still has no address but sits on a named road per the cached Nominatim lookup ('street_only'): the road name
--                alone, shown as "Near <street>" and labelled inferred (a nearest road is not an address). Paths / trails are skipped.
--   city: a pin with none takes, in order: a person-checked city (seeds/venue_city_official.csv), the nearest Overture address city (<= radius),
--         the hand-added row's city, a cached Nominatim town, the parent's addr:city, the nearest Overture city within 1 km, then within 5 km,
--         then the Census place containing the pin (else its county) from seeds/venue_place_boundary.csv.
-- A venue that already has an address from OSM or Overture is never overwritten. Privacy rule (owner, 2026-10-16): home-like pins get a city,
-- never a street (`address_withheld` counts what was held back).
--   home signals: OSM building = house / detached / residential / semidetached_house / bungalow on the court, or an unnamed
--   venue with no court marked public (an unnamed private court, or one nobody tagged, in a residential area: unclear = fail safe).
--   exceptions (full address): building = apartments / dormitory, or an apartment / villas / condos / townhomes / residences /
--   HOA / community / clubhouse name.
{% set radius = var('address_fill_radius_m') %}
{% set cell = 0.004 %}
-- city fallback for a pin with no city from anywhere else: the nearest Overture address WITH a city within this distance (own grid, 3x3 cells >= radius)
{% set city_radius = 1000 %}
{% set city_cell = 0.012 %}
-- last resort for remote pins that nothing above names (Nominatim found no town): the nearest Overture address WITH a city within this distance.
-- Cell 0.06 deg >= 5 km in longitude up to latitude 45, so 3x3 cells cover the radius. Only pins still cityless are probed (a small set).
{% set wide_city_radius = 5000 %}
{% set wide_city_cell = 0.06 %}

with v as (
    select venue_id, venue_name, name_source, lat, lon, address_line, city
    from {{ ref('dim_venue') }}
),

court_flags as (
    select
        c.venue_id,
        max(case when lower(coalesce(s.building, '')) in ('house', 'detached', 'residential', 'semidetached_house', 'bungalow') then 1 else 0 end) = 1 as has_home_building,
        max(case when lower(coalesce(s.building, '')) in ('apartments', 'dormitory') then 1 else 0 end) = 1 as has_apartment_building,
        max(case when c.access_type = 'public' then 1 else 0 end) = 1                                       as has_public_court,
        max(case when c.address_line is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 1                                     as court_has_address
    from {{ ref('dim_court') }} c
    join {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }} s on s.court_id = c.court_id
    group by c.venue_id
),

flags as (
    select
        v.venue_id,
        case
            when coalesce(f.has_apartment_building, false) then false
            when regexp_matches(lower(coalesce(v.venue_name, '')), 'apartment|villas|condo|townhom|residences|hoa|community|clubhouse') then false
            when coalesce(f.has_home_building, false) then true
            when v.name_source = 'unnamed' and not coalesce(f.has_public_court, false) then true
            else false
        end as is_home_like
    from v
    left join court_flags f on f.venue_id = v.venue_id
),

-- nearest address point: grid join (own cell + 8 neighbours, an equi-join), flat-earth distance as in int_court_pairs
venue_cells as (
    select venue_id, lat, lon,
           cast(floor(lat / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cy,
           cast(floor(lon / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cx
    from v
    where address_line is null and lat is not null and lon is not null
),

offsets as (
    select -1 as d union all select 0 union all select 1
),

probe as (
    select a.venue_id, a.lat, a.lon, a.cy + dy.d as ny, a.cx + dx.d as nx
    from venue_cells a
    cross join offsets dy
    cross join offsets dx
),

address_cells as (
    select address_id, address_line, city, lat, lon,
           cast(floor(lat / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cy,
           cast(floor(lon / {{ cell }}) as bigint) as cx
    from {{ ref('stg_overture_addresses') }}
),

candidates as (
    select
        p.venue_id, b.address_id, b.address_line, b.city,
        sqrt(
              power((p.lat - b.lat) * 110540, 2)
            + power((p.lon - b.lon) * cos(radians(p.lat)) * 111320, 2)
        ) as distance_m
    from probe p
    join address_cells b
        on b.cy = p.ny
       and b.cx = p.nx
),

nearest as (
    select venue_id, address_line, city, distance_m
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by venue_id order by distance_m, address_id) as rn
        from candidates
        where distance_m <= {{ radius }}
    ) x
    where rn = 1
),

-- tier 1b: the address mapped on the smallest enclosing feature (same pick as dim_venue's best_parent), only for venues named after it
parent_pick as (
    select venue_id, address_line, addr_city
    from (
        select c.venue_id, p.address_line, p.addr_city,
               row_number() over (partition by c.venue_id order by cp.parent_area asc, cp.parent_name) as rn
        from {{ ref('dim_court') }} c
        join {{ ref('int_court_parent') }} cp on cp.court_id = c.court_id
        join {{ ref('stg_osm_parents') }} p on p.parent_id = cp.parent_id
    ) x
    where rn = 1 and address_line is not null
),

-- official street from the venue's own page; a hand-added venue may have merged into a known pin (effective_venue_id)
official as (
    select mm.effective_venue_id as venue_id, min(o.address_line) as address_line
    from {{ ref('venue_address_official') }} o
    join {{ ref('int_manual_venue_match') }} mm on mm.venue_key = o.venue_key
    group by 1
),

-- the hand-added row's own city (the page it was read from), for a pin whose other sources name none
manual_city as (
    select mm.effective_venue_id as venue_id, min(nullif(trim(m.city), '')) as city
    from {{ ref('stg_manual_venues') }} m
    join {{ ref('int_manual_venue_match') }} mm on mm.venue_key = m.venue_key
    group by 1
),

city_probe as (
    select venue_id, lat, lon,
           cast(floor(lat / {{ city_cell }}) as bigint) + dy.d as ny,
           cast(floor(lon / {{ city_cell }}) as bigint) + dx.d as nx
    from v
    cross join offsets dy
    cross join offsets dx
    where city is null and lat is not null and lon is not null
),

city_points as (
    select city, lat, lon,
           cast(floor(lat / {{ city_cell }}) as bigint) as cy,
           cast(floor(lon / {{ city_cell }}) as bigint) as cx
    from {{ ref('stg_overture_addresses') }}
    where city is not null and city <> ''
),

-- min_by, not row_number(): the window sorted ~43M probe x address candidates (the slowest step of the whole build)
nearby_city as (
    select p.venue_id,
           min_by(b.city, {'d2': power((p.lat - b.lat) * 110540, 2) + power((p.lon - b.lon) * cos(radians(p.lat)) * 111320, 2), 'city': b.city}) as city
    from city_probe p
    join city_points b on b.cy = p.ny and b.cx = p.nx
    group by p.venue_id
    having min(power((p.lat - b.lat) * 110540, 2) + power((p.lon - b.lon) * cos(radians(p.lat)) * 111320, 2)) <= {{ city_radius }} * {{ city_radius }}
),

-- a person-checked city from the venue's own or a listing page (seeds/venue_city_official.csv); counts only while the pin is where it was checked
official_city as (
    select o.venue_id, o.city
    from {{ ref('venue_city_official') }} o
    join v on v.venue_id = o.venue_id
    where abs(v.lat - cast(o.lat as double)) < 0.0003 and abs(v.lon - cast(o.lon as double)) < 0.0003
),

-- a cached row counts only while the pin is still where it was queried (venue_id can shift when pins merge or split)
nominatim as (
    select m.venue_id, m.address_line, m.city, cast(m.distance_m as integer) as distance_m
    from {{ ref('nominatim_addresses') }} m
    join v on v.venue_id = m.venue_id
    where m.status = 'address' and m.address_line is not null
      and abs(v.lat - cast(m.lat as double)) < 0.0003 and abs(v.lon - cast(m.lon as double)) < 0.0003
),

-- the road a pin sits on (no house number), for "Near <street>"; trails, paths and loops are not streets people navigate by
nominatim_street as (
    select m.venue_id, m.address_line as street
    from {{ ref('nominatim_addresses') }} m
    join v on v.venue_id = m.venue_id
    where m.status = 'street_only' and m.address_line is not null and m.address_line <> ''
      and not regexp_matches(lower(m.address_line), 'trail|path|loop|course|greenway|walk|track|alley|driveway|parking')
      and abs(v.lat - cast(m.lat as double)) < 0.0003 and abs(v.lon - cast(m.lon as double)) < 0.0003
),

-- city only, from any cached lookup (street_only / too_far rows included): a city never names a street, so it is safe for
-- every pin, and it feeds the map's location search
nominatim_city as (
    select m.venue_id, m.city
    from {{ ref('nominatim_addresses') }} m
    join v on v.venue_id = m.venue_id
    where m.city is not null and m.city <> ''
      and abs(v.lat - cast(m.lat as double)) < 0.0003 and abs(v.lon - cast(m.lon as double)) < 0.0003
),

-- pins every source above leaves cityless
still_cityless as (
    select v.venue_id, v.lat, v.lon
    from v
    left join nearest n on n.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join nominatim nm on nm.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join nominatim_city nc on nc.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join parent_pick pp on pp.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join manual_city mc on mc.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join nearby_city ny on ny.venue_id = v.venue_id
    left join official_city oc on oc.venue_id = v.venue_id
    where v.city is null and v.lat is not null and v.lon is not null
      and coalesce(n.city, nm.city, nc.city, mc.city, pp.addr_city, ny.city, oc.city) is null
),

wide_probe as (
    select venue_id, lat, lon,
           cast(floor(lat / {{ wide_city_cell }}) as bigint) + dy.d as ny,
           cast(floor(lon / {{ wide_city_cell }}) as bigint) + dx.d as nx
    from still_cityless
    cross join offsets dy
    cross join offsets dx
),

wide_points as (
    select city, lat, lon,
           cast(floor(lat / {{ wide_city_cell }}) as bigint) as cy,
           cast(floor(lon / {{ wide_city_cell }}) as bigint) as cx
    from {{ ref('stg_overture_addresses') }}
    where city is not null and city <> ''
),

wide_city as (
    select venue_id, city
    from (
        select p.venue_id, b.city,
               row_number() over (partition by p.venue_id order by
                   power((p.lat - b.lat) * 110540, 2) + power((p.lon - b.lon) * cos(radians(p.lat)) * 111320, 2), b.city) as rn,
               power((p.lat - b.lat) * 110540, 2) + power((p.lon - b.lon) * cos(radians(p.lat)) * 111320, 2) as d2
        from wide_probe p
        join wide_points b on b.cy = p.ny and b.cx = p.nx
    ) x
    where rn = 1 and d2 <= {{ wide_city_radius }} * {{ wide_city_radius }}
),

-- the Census place (city or census-designated place) whose boundary contains the pin, else the county: the final fallback, for pins no address
-- point names (ingestion/place_from_boundaries.py -> seeds/venue_place_boundary.csv; the pin must still be where it was looked up)
boundary_place as (
    select b.venue_id, b.place_name as city
    from {{ ref('venue_place_boundary') }} b
    join v on v.venue_id = b.venue_id
    where abs(v.lat - cast(b.lat as double)) < 0.0003 and abs(v.lon - cast(b.lon as double)) < 0.0003
)

select
    v.venue_id,
    fl.is_home_like,
    case
        when v.address_line is not null then v.address_line
        when o.address_line is not null then o.address_line
        when v.name_source = 'enclosing_feature' and pp.address_line is not null then pp.address_line
        when not fl.is_home_like then coalesce(n.address_line, nm.address_line)
    end                                                       as address_line,
    case
        when v.address_line is not null and coalesce(cf.court_has_address, false) then 'osm'
        when v.address_line is not null                                           then 'overture_place'
        when o.address_line is not null                                           then 'official'
        when v.name_source = 'enclosing_feature' and pp.address_line is not null  then 'osm_parent'
        when not fl.is_home_like and n.address_line is not null                  then 'overture_nearest'
        when not fl.is_home_like and nm.address_line is not null                 then 'nominatim'
    end                                                       as address_source,
    case when v.address_line is null and (o.address_line is not null
              or (v.name_source = 'enclosing_feature' and pp.address_line is not null)) then null
         when v.address_line is null and not fl.is_home_like and n.address_line is not null
         then cast(round(n.distance_m) as integer)
         when v.address_line is null and not fl.is_home_like and nm.address_line is not null
         then nm.distance_m end                               as address_distance_m,
    -- city for a pin with none (city is not sensitive: it never names a street); used by the map's location search
    coalesce(v.city, oc.city, n.city, nm.city, nc.city, mc.city, pp.addr_city, ny.city, wc.city, bp.city) as city,
    (v.address_line is null and o.address_line is null and fl.is_home_like and n.address_line is not null) as address_withheld,
    case when v.address_line is null and o.address_line is null and not fl.is_home_like
              and not (v.name_source = 'enclosing_feature' and pp.address_line is not null)
              and n.address_line is null and nm.address_line is null
         then ns.street end                                   as near_street
from v
join flags fl on fl.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join court_flags cf on cf.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join nearest n on n.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join nominatim nm on nm.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join nominatim_city nc on nc.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join parent_pick pp on pp.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join nominatim_street ns on ns.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join official o on o.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join manual_city mc on mc.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join nearby_city ny on ny.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join official_city oc on oc.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join wide_city wc on wc.venue_id = v.venue_id
left join boundary_place bp on bp.venue_id = v.venue_id

test.courtconnect.assert_no_duplicate_os.name: assert_no_duplicate_osm_courts
test.courtconnect.assert_no_duplicate_os.raw_code:
-- Fails (returns rows) if two OSM pitch ways of the same sport sit within osm_court_duplicate_radius_m of each other:
-- stg_osm_courts should have kept only the lower id, otherwise the venue's court count is inflated.
-- Pitches are bucketed by (sport tag, latitude cell of 0.0001 deg) and probed in the cell and its two neighbours, so
-- the join is an equi-join; the old `abs(a.lat - b.lat) < 0.0001` range join took ~110 s.
with pitches as (
    select court_id, lat, lon, sport_tag_delimited, cast(floor(lat / 0.0001) as bigint) as cy
    from {{ ref('stg_osm_courts') }}
    where osm_leisure_type = 'pitch'
),

probe as (
    select a.*, a.cy + d.d as ny
    from pitches a
    cross join (select -1 as d union all select 0 union all select 1) d
)

select a.court_id as kept, b.court_id as duplicate
from probe a
join pitches b
    on b.sport_tag_delimited = a.sport_tag_delimited
   and b.cy = a.ny
   and a.court_id < b.court_id
where abs(a.lat - b.lat) < 0.0001
  and sqrt(
          power((a.lat - b.lat) * 110540, 2)
        + power((a.lon - b.lon) * cos(radians(a.lat)) * 111320, 2)
      ) <= {{ var('osm_court_duplicate_radius_m') }}

test.courtconnect.assert_sport_evidence_.name: assert_sport_evidence_unique
test.courtconnect.assert_sport_evidence_.raw_code:
-- One ladder row per (venue, sport), and every venue-sport the finder lists has one.
select venue_id, sport_id, count(*) as n
from {{ ref('mart_sport_evidence') }}
group by 1, 2
having count(*) > 1
union all
select b.venue_id, b.sport_id, 0
from {{ ref('bridge_venue_sport') }} b
left join {{ ref('mart_sport_evidence') }} e on e.venue_id = b.venue_id and e.sport_id = b.sport_id
where e.venue_id is null

seed.courtconnect.venue_opening_status.name: venue_opening_status
seed.courtconnect.venue_opening_status.description: Hand-added venues (manual_venues, by venue_key) that are confirmed but NOT OPEN YET. The map still shows them, with a hollow pin and an "Opening soon" badge, because the owner wants every padel, pop tennis and beach tennis place visible. 'Opening soon' = the club's own page (or an official page) says it is coming; 'Reported: opening soon' = only a directory or press listing says so (shown as a lighter pin). Only add a venue whose own page (or an official page) says it is coming for 'Opening soon'; remove the row when it opens (and update the venue's `rules`). `evidence` says what the page said and `verified_on` when.

model.courtconnect.stg_osm_courts.name: stg_osm_courts
model.courtconnect.stg_osm_courts.description: One row per OpenStreetMap element (a single court or a facility such as a sports centre), tags standardised. Keeps only records whose sport tag maps to a racket sport on the sheet (osm_sport_map; ADR 0004) and drops the same court drawn twice.
model.courtconnect.stg_osm_courts.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}   -- 12 models read this; as a view its dedupe self-join re-ran for each
-- One row per OSM element (a single court, or a facility such as a sports centre), tags standardised.
-- Only records whose sport tag maps to a racket sport on the master sheet are kept
-- (e.g. a pitch tagged only 'tetherball' is dropped, see ADR 0004).
with src as (
    select o.*
    from {{ source('raw', 'osm_courts') }} o
    where o.lat is not null and o.lon is not null
      and exists (
          select 1 from {{ ref('osm_sport_map') }} m
          where ';' || lower(replace(o.sport, ' ', '')) || ';' like '%;' || m.osm_sport_key || ';%'
      )
),

-- The same court is sometimes drawn twice in OSM (two pitch ways, same sport tag, same spot: leftovers of aerial
-- tracing passes), which doubled its court count (Van Nuys Sherman Oaks Tennis Courts showed 16 instead of 8). Keep the
-- way with the lower id. Only pitch-vs-pitch: a sports centre or stadium legitimately sits on top of its courts.
deduped as (
    select s.*
    from src s
    where not (
        s.leisure = 'pitch'
        and exists (
            select 1
            from src d
            where d.leisure = 'pitch'
              and lower(replace(d.sport, ' ', '')) = lower(replace(s.sport, ' ', ''))
              and (d.osm_id < s.osm_id or (d.osm_id = s.osm_id and d.osm_type < s.osm_type))
              and abs(d.lat - s.lat) < 0.0001
              and sqrt(
                      power((d.lat - s.lat) * 110540, 2)
                    + power((d.lon - s.lon) * cos(radians(s.lat)) * 111320, 2)
                  ) <= {{ var('osm_court_duplicate_radius_m') }}
        )
    )
)

select
    osm_type || '/' || cast(osm_id as varchar)                as court_id,
    nullif(trim(name), '')                                    as court_name,
    cast(lat as double)                                       as lat,
    cast(lon as double)                                       as lon,
    ';' || lower(replace(sport, ' ', '')) || ';'              as sport_tag_delimited,

    -- a 'pitch' is one court; everything else is a facility that contains or names courts
    case when leisure = 'pitch' then 'court' else 'facility' end as record_kind,

    -- playing surface, grouped. First match wins, most specific first.
    case
        when lower(coalesce(surface, '')) = ''                                          then 'unknown'
        when lower(surface) like '%sand%'                                               then 'sand'
        when lower(surface) like '%clay%'                                               then 'clay'
        when lower(surface) like '%artificial%' or lower(surface) like '%turf%'         then 'turf'
        when lower(surface) like '%grass%'                                              then 'grass'
        when lower(surface) like '%carpet%'                                             then 'carpet'
        when lower(surface) like '%wood%' or lower(surface) like '%parquet%'            then 'wood'
        when lower(surface) like '%asphalt%' or lower(surface) like '%concrete%'
          or lower(surface) like '%acrylic%' or lower(surface) like '%hard%'
          or lower(surface) like '%paved%' or lower(surface) like '%paving%'
          or lower(surface) like '%tartan%' or lower(surface) like '%rubber%'
          or lower(surface) like '%plastic%'                                            then 'hard'
        else 'other'
    end                                                       as surface_type,

    -- indoor / covered / outdoor
    case
        when lower(coalesce(indoor, '')) = 'yes' or leisure = 'sports_hall'
          or (building is not null and lower(building) <> 'no')                        then 'indoor'
        when lower(coalesce(covered, '')) = 'yes'                                       then 'covered'
        when lower(coalesce(indoor, '')) = 'no'                                         then 'outdoor'
        when leisure = 'pitch'                                                          then 'likely_outdoor'  -- untagged: an assumption, not data
        else 'unknown'
    end                                                       as setting,

    lower(coalesce(lit, '')) = 'yes'                          as is_lit,
    case lower(coalesce(access, ''))
        when 'yes' then 'public'
        when 'public' then 'public'
        when 'permissive' then 'public'
        when 'customers' then 'customers'
        when 'private' then 'private'
        when 'members' then 'members'
        else 'unknown'
    end                                                       as access_type,
    case lower(coalesce(fee, '')) when 'no' then true when 'yes' then false end as is_free,
    nullif(trim(operator), '')                                as operator_name,
    nullif(cast(courts as varchar), '')                       as courts_count_raw,
    leisure                                                   as osm_leisure_type,
    nullif(trim(website), '')                                 as website,
    nullif(trim(phone), '')                                   as phone,
    nullif(trim(opening_hours), '')                           as opening_hours,
    nullif(trim(concat_ws(' ', addr_housenumber, addr_street)), '') as address_line,
    nullif(trim(addr_city), '')                               as city,
    lower(nullif(trim(building), ''))                       as building,
    extracted_at,
    {{ region_code('region') }}                               as region
from deduped

{% macro duckdb__get_catalog_tables_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select *
    from (
        select
            t.database_name as table_database,
            t.schema_name as table_schema,
            t.table_name as table_name,
            'BASE TABLE' as table_type,
            t.comment as table_comment
        from duckdb_tables() t
        where upper(t.database_name) = upper('{{ information_schema.database }}')

        union all

        select
            v.database_name as table_database,
            v.schema_name as table_schema,
            v.view_name as table_name,
            'VIEW' as table_type,
            v.comment as table_comment
        from duckdb_views() v
        where upper(v.database_name) = upper('{{ information_schema.database }}')
    ) catalog_tables

            c.column_index as column_index,
            c.data_type as column_type,

macro.elementary.default__freshness_metr.name: default__freshness_metric_query
macro.elementary.default__freshness_metr.macro_sql:
{% macro default__freshness_metric_query(metric, metric_properties) %}
    -- get ordered consecutive update timestamps in the source data
    with
        unique_timestamps as (
            select distinct monitored_table_timestamp_column as timestamp_val
            from partially_time_filtered_monitored_table
            order by 1
        ),

        -- compute freshness for every update as the time difference from the previous
        -- update
        consecutive_updates_freshness as (
            select
                timestamp_val as update_timestamp,
                {{ elementary._freshness_lag_expr() }} as freshness
            from unique_timestamps
        ),
        time_filtered_consecutive_updates_freshness as (
            select *
            from consecutive_updates_freshness
            where update_timestamp >= (select min(edr_bucket_start) from buckets)
        ),
        -- divide the freshness metrics above to buckets
        bucketed_consecutive_updates_freshness as (
            select edr_bucket_start, edr_bucket_end, update_timestamp, freshness
            from buckets
            cross join time_filtered_consecutive_updates_freshness
            where
                update_timestamp >= edr_bucket_start
                and update_timestamp < edr_bucket_end
        ),

        -- we also want to record the freshness at the end of each bucket as an
        -- additional point. By this we mean
        -- the time that passed since the last update in the bucket and the end of the
        -- bucket.
        bucket_end_freshness as (
            select
                edr_bucket_start,
                edr_bucket_end,
                max(timestamp_val) as update_timestamp,
                {{ elementary._bucket_end_freshness_expr() }} as freshness
            from buckets
            cross join unique_timestamps
            where timestamp_val < edr_bucket_end
            group by edr_bucket_start, edr_bucket_end
        ),

        -- create a single table with all the freshness values
        bucket_all_freshness_metrics as (
            select *
            from bucketed_consecutive_updates_freshness
            union all
            select *
            from bucket_end_freshness
        ),

        -- get all the freshness values, ranked by size (we use partition by and not
        -- group by, because we also want to have
        -- the associated timestamp as source value)
        bucket_freshness_ranked as (
            select
                *,
                row_number() over (
                    partition by edr_bucket_end
                    order by freshness is null, freshness desc
                ) as row_num
            from bucket_all_freshness_metrics
        )

    {{ elementary._freshness_final_select(metric) }}
    from bucket_freshness_ranked
    where row_num = 1
{% endmacro %}
